title: Specifier("===") with no version is accepted
spec:
This is the `packaging` library (Python 3, no dependencies; the code is in `src/packaging/`). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests --ignore=tests/property` (about a minute).

```python
from packaging.specifiers import Specifier
Specifier("===")
```

Expected: raises `InvalidSpecifier`.
Actual: returns `<Specifier('===')>`.

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
